description: Riego CyL: zonas regables is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by idecyl.jcyl.es. Map of irrigable areas of Castile and Leon. Cartographic representation of the sectors of irrigable areas in the Community of Castilla y León. Program for the sustainable promotion of water resources in irrigated areas. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "CyL irrigation: irrigable areas" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 3 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2023-04-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
